column1: # The functions through which an image's Lua bindings read their arguments: read by `exemap binding-args`
# (mercs2_exemap::bindingargs). `index` is the 0-based argument of the call that holds the Lua stack
# position, or `@N` for a reader that always reads position N whatever it is passed; `slots` is how many consecutive positions it reads (`1..2`: one, and the next when it is a
# table); `reads` is what it takes. Each row's evidence is the reader's own body in the image's decomp.
# Lua 5.1 API of x360-retail, from their bodies: 0x827df138 lua_type, 0x827df1f0 lua_isnumber,
# 0x827df650 lua_touserdata; 0x827e16b8 raises the argument type error (its third argument the expected type).

column6: evidence
isnumber then tonumber at the index, stored as a float; returns 1
isnumber then tonumber at the index, stored as an int; returns 1
lua_type 1 (boolean) or 0 (nil), then toboolean; returns 1
isstring (type 4 or 3) then tolstring; returns 1
reads a string (0x82308430) and hashes it with 0x82855718 (pandemic_hash_m2); returns the hash
lua_type 2 (light userdata) then touserdata; returns 1
calls 0x823089b8 at the same index

isstring then tolstring at position 1 (its index argument is unused), copied to at most 64 bytes
